summary.target: Evidence-backed experience architecture for governed dashboard redesign and adoption

gaps.title: No canonical experience-audit package
gaps.claim: The repository has several dashboard reports but not the full Kaoshi audit inventory package required by the handoff.
gaps.recommendation: Create experience-audit repository-map, surfaces, components, visualizations, contracts, gaps, decisions, roadmap, and evidence-ledger files.
gaps.validation: Inventory files exist and each material claim includes evidence paths.

gaps.title: Experience contract standard is not fully enforced
gaps.claim: Dashboard data contracts exist, but full purpose/data/state/interaction/freshness/responsive/accessibility/performance/security/observability/quality/governance contracts are not yet required for every reusable capability.
gaps.recommendation: Add a machine-readable experience contract schema and require it for major components, visualizations, and dashboard surfaces.
gaps.validation: Example contracts validate and Kashi Market Intelligence has a complete draft contract.

gaps.title: Visualization admission rules are still advisory
gaps.claim: Chart primitives exist, but the system does not yet force chart choice to be tied to user question, data shape, freshness, interaction, and fallback.
gaps.recommendation: Create a visualization intent matrix and chart admission checklist with required accessible fallback and proof states.
gaps.validation: Kashi chart usage maps to the matrix and one-off chart usage is detected in reports.

gaps.title: Required end-to-end feature traces are absent
gaps.claim: The handoff requires five representative feature traces. The repo does not yet have a consolidated feature trace artifact.
gaps.recommendation: Trace simple CRUD, analytical dashboard, live view, AI workflow, and high-risk action through data, state, UI, permissions, telemetry, accessibility, and tests.
gaps.validation: Feature trace file lists five complete traces with evidence paths and failure modes.

gaps.title: Production proof adoption is incomplete
gaps.claim: Proof endpoint and screenshot capture rules exist, but downstream dashboards still lack complete proof baselines.
gaps.recommendation: Require readonly proofUrl entries and screenshot baselines for priority dashboards before world-class status.
gaps.validation: Production proof registry has no baseline-needed entries for priority dashboards.

gaps.title: Visual quality scoring is not premium enough
gaps.claim: The current visual score catches generic failures but still requires human/Mobbin review for premium dashboard quality.
gaps.recommendation: Expand visual QA to score chart polish, density, hierarchy, interaction affordance, state labels, and data/prototype truthfulness.
gaps.validation: Priority surfaces score at least 90 and include screenshot evidence.

gaps.title: Static adapter can hide incomplete migrations
gaps.claim: Static adapter adoption improves consistency but does not guarantee package-native behavior, richer state, or live data interactions.
gaps.recommendation: Use static adapter only as a bridge; require package-native migration plans for priority dashboards.
gaps.validation: Migration backlog identifies package-native target state for each priority dashboard.

gaps.title: Telemetry normalization remains uneven across projects
gaps.claim: Some projects are adoption-current while still missing complete telemetry-normalized maturity.
gaps.recommendation: Standardize health, cost, queue, capacity, activity, action-needed, freshness, and error telemetry across project manifests.
gaps.validation: Maturity report shows priority projects at telemetry-normalized levels.

roadmap: V3 Visualization decision and wrapper layer
V7 Broad adoption across priority dashboards
